# Automatically compare remedial models

<small>Source: [`R/advancedRemediation.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/advancedRemediation.R) · Help: `?autoCompareRemediations`</small>

Fits several remedial models for heteroscedasticity and compares
their performance using AIC and residual RMSE. Currently evaluates
weighted least squares and robust regression against the original
model.

## Usage

```r
autoCompareRemediations(model, data = NULL)
```

## Arguments

`model`
:   Fitted `lm` model or formula.

`data`
:   Optional data frame if `model` is a formula.

## Value

A list with components `metrics`, `models`, and `best` indicating
the recommended method.

## Examples

```r
data(mtcars)
m <- lm(mpg ~ wt + qsec, mtcars)
autoCompareRemediations(m)
```
